arguments.sql: SELECT MIN(t.date) AS first_fraud_txn, MAX(t.date) AS last_fraud_txn FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Returns the earliest and latest dates among transactions labelled as fraud.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; transactions without a label are excluded rather than treated as non-fraud.
Dates are compared as stored text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so the result includes the time of day.
